name: claude-mods
description: Nine Claude Code mods: prompt shaping, a task bar, a cache clock, handoffs, saved rules, a chat inventory, screen-share hiding, an edit replay and a /mods switchboard.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Turns a long, rambling voice dump into a clear, structured prompt. Asks short multiple-choice questions about real gaps, then puts the result in your prompt box to check.

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: A task progress bar above the prompt that fills as Claude ticks off its to-do list, plus a side pane with one live card per subagent.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Counts down above the prompt until the chat's prompt cache goes cold, with a capped, priced Keep warm option and a handoff offer for big chats.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: When a chat gets very long, writes a handoff of the whole chat and starts a fresh chat with it. Saves a draft first and never loses your work.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: When you correct Claude, offers to save the fix as a lasting rule. You see the exact text first, and every write can be undone.

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: A side pane listing what this chat used: the to-do list, connectors and calls, files and skills.

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: /screen-share hides names, emails, phone numbers, money amounts and secrets on screen while you record. Claude still reads the real data.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay steps through the file edits Claude made, one diff at a time. Derived from Anthropic's sample under Apache 2.0.

plugins.name: mods
plugins.description: /mods opens a switchboard to turn each mod on or off in every chat, and finds mods from any marketplace.
